name: jocasta
description: Single-plugin marketplace for jocasta, the team tool archive: a GitHub registry repo searched and edited through one Claude Code skill.

plugins.name: jocasta
plugins.description: Describe a need in prose and learn what already answers to it, who owns it, and whether it is still alive; register, retire, adopt, and hand off tools with every write checked by a validator. Includes the instance template that `init` copies to create a team's registry repo.
